name: Nova Launcher Prime
shortDesc: The highly customizable, performance-driven home screen.
description: Nova Launcher Prime is the ultimate customizable launcher. Replace your home screen with one you control and can customize. Change icons, layouts, animations and more. Nova Launcher delivers a highly polished, fast and responsive experience with endless customization options.
whatsNew:
• Android 14 support
• New drawer animations
• Fixed widget padding on foldables
• Performance improvements

name: Pixel Camera Pro
shortDesc: Professional camera with AI enhancements and manual controls.
description: Pixel Camera Pro brings DSLR-like controls to your phone. Shoot in RAW, master manual focus, shutter speed and ISO. AI-powered Night Sight, Portrait and HDR+ take your photos to the next level. Designed for creators who demand perfect shots.
whatsNew:
• Added ProRAW format
• New cinematic blur controls
• Improved low-light processing
• 8K video stabilization

name: Vault Secure
shortDesc: Military-grade vault for photos, videos & private apps.
description: Vault Secure protects your privacy with AES-256 encryption. Hide photos, videos, lock apps with fingerprint, and get intrusion alerts. Decoy vault and break-in snapshots keep your data truly private even if someone knows your PIN.
whatsNew:
• Intrusion selfie v2
• Decoy vault added
• Fingerprint unlock fix

name: BeatFlow Music
shortDesc: Offline music player with equalizer and lyrics sync.
description: BeatFlow is a lightweight offline music player built for audiophiles. 10-band equalizer, gapless playback, synced lyrics, and beautiful adaptive themes. No ads, no tracking — just your music.
whatsNew:
• Gapless playback fix
• Synced lyrics for 50M+ songs
• New AMOLED black theme

name: FitPulse Pro
shortDesc: Track workouts, diet & sleep — all offline.
description: FitPulse Pro is your all-in-one offline fitness companion. Log workouts, count calories with barcode scanner, track sleep cycles, and get AI coaching. Syncs with Wear OS and Mi Band without needing cloud.
whatsNew:
• Wear OS 4 support
• Calorie barcode scanner
• Sleep score improvements

name: TaskNova
shortDesc: Minimal todo & habit tracker with widgets.
description: TaskNova keeps you focused. Minimal design, powerful features: natural language input, recurring tasks, Kanban board, calendar sync, home-screen widgets, and Pomodoro timer — all in under 8 MB.
whatsNew:
• Natural language: 'tomorrow 5pm'
• Kanban board view
• Pomodoro timer widget
